create_SO3_exp: create an SO3 rotation from a 3D axis-angle vector using the exponential map
create_SO3_log: compute the logarithmic map of an SO3 rotation to get its Lie algebra vector
build_SO3_matrix: build a 3x3 rotation matrix from an SO3 quaternion-based rotation object
test_SO3_hat_vee: test the hat and vee operators to convert between skew-symmetric matrices and 3D vectors
refactor_SO3_mul: refactor SO3 left-multiplication to compose two rotations or transform a 3D point
